title: Air Force JTACs Call For First B 52 Drop In Morocco
description: For the first time during African Lion, Air Force JTACs call for bomb drops from a B 52 bomber. US Army Video by SGT James Dansie.

transcript.text: My name is Senior, I'm in Christian Miller. I'm here supporting the 2A SAWs in the United States Air Force.
This is a JTAC for African Line 2018. Today we are conducting live fire exercises with Air Force P-52s, Moroccan F-16s,
and we have a Spanish mortar team behind me. We're all doing live fire. It's good training, good practice, just all that integration and interoperability for all the nations,
just to see where we're at and what we can improve on. Coming here, being able to teach them something that's predominantly our craft
and something that we're really good at, it helps us learn and become better as instructors and JTACs, having to teach someone else because you want to make sure you're
squared away, across your keys and dot in your eyes, and it's also pretty rewarding being able to see them do it in action.
You know, teach them one day and then the next day they come out here and do it for real.

pass_reason: no bomb drop or impact on screen; mostly briefings
